```sql
SELECT 
    "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" AS FreeRate
FROM 
    frpm
ORDER BY 
    FreeRate ASC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" AS FreeRate
FROM 
    frpm
WHERE 
    "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 
    FreeRate ASC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    PERCENTAGE as "Lowest Three Eligible Free Rates"
FROM (
    SELECT 
        "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)" AS PERCENTAGE,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY "Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS RN
    FROM frpm
)
WHERE RN <= 3;
```

```sql
SELECT rate
FROM student_free_rates
WHERE age BETWEEN 5 AND 17 AND school_type = 'continuation'
ORDER BY rate ASC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
SELECT rate
FROM student_rates
WHERE age BETWEEN 5 AND 17 AND school_type = 'continuation' AND is_free = true
ORDER BY rate ASC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
SELECT TOP 3 fee_rate
FROM student_fee
WHERE age BETWEEN 5 AND 17
AND school_type = 'continuation'
ORDER BY fee_rate ASC;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)]
FROM 
    frpm
JOIN 
    schools ON frpm.NCESSchool = schools.NCESSchool
WHERE 
    schools.AgeGroup = '5-17'
ORDER BY 
    frpm.[Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)] ASC
LIMIT 3;
```
